authority: contract .agent/kernel/lanes/w42-bundle042.md (RW3 'timing per the A/B rules or disclosed'); _WAVE_V042_COMMON.md A/B rule (interleaved, one lock session, core watch 3,13,19,29, sweep-class abort, everything else disclosed with the arm's own runqueue wait + cgroup CPU pressure, A/A and B/B spreads); verdict rule = w41-rw3add PREREG c423594b / PREREG2 b8e1fef2 (unchanged)

case.name: WN3 0227 3-nest (wg_20260227_18z_a1)
case.provenance: copy of the w42-harness guarded facade_stage copy (STAGED_INDEX 24/24 SHA match; <USER_HOME>/wrf_gpu2_lanes/w42-harness/stage_receipt/facade_stage.json)

arms.N: v0.4.2 sealed bundle <DATA_ROOT>/wrf_gpu2/release_bundles/v0.4.2 (its tools/bundle_consumer.sh, fresh layer)
arms.O: v0.4.1 sealed bundle <DATA_ROOT>/wrf_gpu2/release_bundles/v0.4.1 (its tools/bundle_consumer.sh, fresh layer; READ-ONLY, BUNDLE_OK before/after)
arms.order: N72 N1 O1 N2 O2 N3 O3 O72 (N72 first: it is also the RW1 72 h warm replay and the RW3 D6 input)
arms.session: phase 2 of ONE with_gpu_lock session (phase 1 = prime/seal/replays); window end = min(session start + 120 min, 2026-10-19T18:30:00Z); a slot starts only if its need (24 h 270 s, 72 h 650 s) fits

abort_rules.watcher: core_watch.py (frozen a4938233) 1 s on cores 3,13,19,29, own session tree excluded
abort_rules.rule_P: one foreign process > 100 % of one core on the gated cores for > 10 s cumulative -> abort
abort_rules.rule_A: sum of foreign on-core shares > 200 % for > 10 s cumulative -> abort
abort_rules.shadow: never-aborting watcher at the 20/50 % contract rules -> disclosure + strict subset
abort_rules.repeat: aborted arm kept as <slot>.abortedK, slot repeated with fresh dir + layer, max 3 tries
abort_rules.pre_gate: 60 s quiet stretch (same thresholds at 3 s), rolling, max 180 s per slot, then start (BUSY_START disclosed); busy while updatedb runs
abort_rules.hold: manager HOLD/STOP line to w42-bundle042 stops before the next arm
abort_rules.post_arm_contention: none gated (v0.4.2 common rule): CLI main-thread runqueue wait share, cgroup cpu.pressure, <DATA_ROOT> await, foreign agg mean are DISCLOSED per arm

bundle_checks: compile_bundle.py check BUNDLE_OK missing=0 changed=0 new=0 on the arm's bundle before AND after every arm, else stop the session
acceptance: accept.py: rc 0 + CUDA device; BUNDLE_CONSUMER rc=0 compiled_new=0 + both checks OK; watcher present/healthy; final within_rule, no ABORT; continuous coverage t0..t_end

metrics.primary: stepping median per arm = median of the d03 hourly publication intervals, leads 2..H (s per forecast hour, all 3 domains; attrib_detail d03_step_median) - manager 2026-10-19T05:59:13Z
secondary_disclosed: whole-run s/fc-h = last original wrfout mtime minus process t0, / H (E162); an arm whose arm-window <DATA_ROOT> (nvme3n1) await > 50 ms (disk_watch; iostat -x logged per arm) is whole-run DISTURBED: disclosed, excluded from the whole-run pooled ratio, never called a regression

verdict_rule.basis: counted 24 h arms; pooled N/O = mean(N) / mean(O) of the primary metric; spread S = max(A/A over O, B/B over N) with A/A = max/min - 1 over counted arms of one kind
verdict_rule.REAL_REGRESSION: pooled N/O - S > 1.10 -> STOP, name suspects
verdict_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: otherwise, or fewer than 2 counted arms of either kind
verdict_rule.72h: N72/O72 reported as one pair (not in the pooled rule)
verdict_rule.strict: arms whose shadow watcher would also pass 20/50 % reported separately

budgets.24h: arm.sh 330 s, scope RuntimeMaxSec 420 s, MemoryMax 20G

env: AT_* defaults of rw3t.sh (RULE_P 100, RULE_A 200, QGATE 60 s, GATE_MAX 180 s, WATCH_CPU 8, SAMPLE_CPU 9) unless the session log START line says otherwise
